overview_description.description: Velar is a fintech and blockchain company founded in 2023, focused on building decentralized finance (DeFi) infrastructure on the Bitcoin network. It provides a suite of applications—including a decentralized exchange (DEX), perpetual trading (PerpDEX), liquidity pools, staking, and a token launchpad—designed to unlock Bitcoin’s potential beyond simple transactions. Built on Bitcoin Layer-2 solutions like Stacks, Velar enables users to perform advanced financial activities such as token swaps, yield farming, and leveraged trading while benefiting from Bitcoin’s security and finality.

product.name: Velar Dex
product.description: A decentralized exchange on Bitcoin Layer 2 allowing users to swap digital assets in a permissionless and secure manner with minimal fees.

product.name: Velar Artha Perpdex
product.description: A perpetual derivatives exchange on Bitcoin allowing users to trade perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage while retaining custody of their assets.

product.name: Velar Staking
product.description: A staking program allowing users to stake $VELAR tokens to earn benefits such as IDO participation, trading fee discounts, and access to incentivized testnets.

product.name: Velar Launchpad
product.description: A platform for launching new token projects on Bitcoin, providing a streamlined process for token sales and community building.

product.name: Velar Bridge
product.description: A cross-chain bridge enabling seamless transfer of assets between Bitcoin and other blockchains.

product.name: Velar SDK
product.description: A developer toolkit offering APIs and tools to build decentralized finance applications on Bitcoin Layer 2 with Velar's infrastructure.
